title: Mythical Agriculture x Tensura
description: Compatbility mod for Mystical Agriculture (and Mystical Agradditions) x Tensura: Reincarnated
body:
This datapack adds a compatibility for Mystical Agriculture (and Mystical Agradditions) x Tensura: Reincarnated by adding EP to tools and gear, and other miscellaneous stuff.

The crops files needed for the update can be found on my github page. Either in the links sidebard or [here](https://github.com/Whelpiana/Mythical-Agriculture-x-Tensura).

This new update adds Mystical Customization as a required dependency to fully experience the datapack.

The files inside the crops file will need to be placed inside /config/mysticalcustomization/crops/


**Mystical Agriculture**

New crops:

- Silver (Tier 2)
- Dragon (Tier 4)
- Elemental (Tier 4)
- Magisteel (Tier 4)
- Daemon (Tier 5)
- Mithril (Tier 5)
- Orichalcum (Tier 5)

Added seed recipes and essence conversion recipes, allowing the new essences to be crafted into their respective Tensura resources.


Added EP to all of its tools and gears. 
Added a way for all tools and gears to evolve to a heigher tier by gaining EP.
Added the Tsukumogami Engraving to all Awakened Supremium tools and gears.
Added a way for Great Sage to refine Deepslate/Normal Inferium Ore to output more Inferium Essence.
Added a way for Great Sage to refine Deepslate/Normal Prosperity Ore to output more Prosperity Shards.


**Mystical Agradditions**

Not required for the datapack to work.

Added EP to the Paxel.
Added a way for the Paxel to evolve to a heigher tier by gaining EP.
Added the Tsukumogami Engraving to Awakened Supremium Paxel.
Added a way for Great Sage to refine End/Nether Inferium Ore to output more Inferium Essence.
Added a way for Great Sage to refine End/Nether Prosperity Ore to output more Prosperity Shards.


Do leave feedback if specifics parts of the datapack are unbalanced.
Do leave suggestions.
